transcript.text: Here are the details of the higher-headquarters signal-readiness directive I received this morning after the briefing. The directive requires that the West relay site be validated first, on Tuesday, from exactly 0900 to 1000, and that its results must be reported by 1200 that same day. This directive arrived after the morning briefing and has not yet been added to the battalion signal plan. This directly conflicts with the proposed routine schedule, which had East relay on Tuesday 0900-1100 and West relay on Thursday 0900-1100. We'll need to adjust the plan so West goes first on Tuesday in that one-hour window, and then figure out how to fit East in around it.
